rules.claim: The Download action is the detail GET action and delegates to file_response(pk, request, "attachment"); it converts FileNotFoundError and Document.DoesNotExist to HTTP 404.

dependencies.reason: The delegated file_response call resolves the request/root document, selects the effective file document, and supplies the file-serving effect; its source body is required to compare the authorized object with the returned file.

rules.claim: The Download action is the detail GET action and delegates to file_response(pk, request, "attachment"); FileNotFoundError and Document.DoesNotExist are translated to HTTP 404.

dependencies.reason: Version selection and file selection occur in the delegated file_response path, so that source body must be read to determine omitted, valid, unrelated, and invalid version behavior.

sourceBindings.claim: The path identifier is loaded as request_doc, including deleted documents for file_response.
root_doc is obtained from request_doc and is the object passed to the view_document permission check.
file_doc is selected separately from request_doc and root_doc, then passed to serve_file.

rules.claim: When request.user is non-null, file_response permits continuation only if has_perms_owner_aware grants view_document on root_doc.
A non-null request.user lacking view_document permission on root_doc receives HttpResponseForbidden before file_doc is selected or opened.
After the root permission branch allows continuation, serve_file receives the separately selected file_doc, so the protected object and served object can differ.
rules.operation: open and return selected source or archive file

dependencies.reason: The helper determines whether an explicit version may select a document different from the authorized root and which invalid/unavailable inputs fail.
The helper determines the concrete file handle, media type, and filename opened for file_doc.
The helper defines global, owner, and object-grant conditions for the root view_document decision.

sourceBindings.claim: The path pk is resolved to request_doc using the global manager because file_response requests include_deleted=True.
The root document is derived from request_doc and is distinct from the later effective file document.
_get_effective_file_doc selects the Document whose stored representation is passed to serve_file.

rules.claim: If the path-selected request_doc is itself a version document and no version parameter is supplied, that request_doc becomes file_doc.
Otherwise, selection delegates to resolve_requested_version_for_root using root_doc; an explicit version causes include_deleted=True, while omitted version causes include_deleted=False.
A resolution error of INVALID raises NotFound with 'Invalid version parameter'.
If version resolution returns no document, _resolve_file_doc raises Http404.
The selected file_doc is passed to serve_file; therefore selecting another version changes the Document supplying the returned representation.

dependencies.reason: Its body is needed to distinguish omitted version, related version, unrelated version, malformed version, and deleted/unavailable records.
Its parsing behavior determines which inputs count as omitted, valid, or invalid version selection.

rules.claim: After root-document permission succeeds, file_response passes the effective file document to serve_file; the protected file-serving effect therefore uses the effective file document, not necessarily the path-identified request document.
rules.reason: The shown file_response source resolves request_doc and root_doc, obtains file_doc, and passes that file_doc to serve_file.

dependencies.reason: The file_response source directly invokes serve_file with doc=file_doc, so serve_file determines the concrete response file representation.

rules.claim: After root-level authorization succeeds and file_doc has been selected, serve_file opens file_doc.archive_file when use_archive is true, otherwise file_doc.source_file; it sets the response MIME type from the selected representation and constructs the attachment filename from that same document's filename metadata.
When the path-selected document is itself a version and no version parameter is supplied, that request_doc is the effective file document.
After successful root-based resolution, the resolved file_doc is passed to file serving and supplies the stored representation.

sourceBindings.claim: The download chain uses request.user as the principal supplied to the explicit root-document permission check.

dependencies.reason: This helper determines the default/latest and explicit related-version candidate returned from the requested root.
This helper determines whether version input is omitted or supplied and whether parsing is valid.
This helper constrains a selected file document to the requested root or one of that root's version documents.
This helper defines the owner-null, owner-equality, and object-permission branches of the explicit check on root_doc.

rules.claim: After root resolution and a non-forbidden result, file_response selects file_doc and passes that selected document to serve_file.

rules.operation: open and return the selected document's source or archive representation
rules.claim: serve_file opens source_file or archive_file on the selected file_doc and constructs the FileResponse from that handle and the same document's representation metadata.
